title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-09-05-r38.

This front-facing cumulative reader preserves every Korean EGA unit admitted by source, translation, typesetting and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme/table of contents; and a contiguous translation of the EGA II main text through §2.2.1, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1683. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete; the next source work begins at canonical line 1685. No claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, perfection or external human certification is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean EGA lineage. The exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22346664 identifies this immutable r38 checkpoint. Working repository: github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko.

The r38 increment translates §§2.1.10–2.1.11, the heading for §2.2, and §2.2.1, canonical lines 1607–1683. It treats ideals and radicals in S_+, the nilradical, essentially reduced rings, zero divisors and essentially integral domains, then introduces the graded fraction ring S_f, its degree-zero subring S_{(f)}, the Laurent-polynomial description of (S^{(d)})_f, and the corresponding construction for graded modules. All 111 inline formulas, 14 emphasis spans, the reference to §2.1.9 and the single historical marker II:24 are structurally bound. Potentially ambiguous source readings at canonical lines 1638 and 1664 were made explicit in the translation controls and routed as source-canon clarifications; no silent repair of the canonical French source was made.

The new source slice is 4,096 characters and 4,191 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 44583D53F17603797145FE63822F3F78DC6ECFD7ADA1B38EF01813F9E3F22BE6. The admitted canonical prefix is 78,088 bytes, SHA-256 7DE4ECF8630F2B575C08ED0EE4AEC560F6BD4C6026C4BC894DD057D4AE1B9B75. The admitted Korean candidate is 4,599 bytes, SHA-256 8D37AF2B8B05D9C938F2D282F58902092FB7FCF55300B0A85B28C9538340CF93; the cumulative Korean EGA II target is 80,222 bytes, SHA-256 4E6C76FDA3FBADCDA044DCD11A38D0BF0764CAACA3D29CD8A3F8067D13B3F006.

The cumulative PDF has 239 pages, 1,485,270 bytes, SHA-256 FEC06D6723BFE9CC7D3C46E285C7DE8A49929F2797FD2F4F47877D2BDA06FE15, and retains 228 historical printed-page markers. Two clean four-pass XeLaTeX cycles converged: passes 3 and 4 were byte-identical within each cycle, and the final PDFs were byte-identical across cycles. The expected pass-2 delta is disclosed in the build evidence rather than suppressed. Evidence binds editable TeX, coverage, source authority, terminology and translation controls, expert-review views, build logs, independent extraction paths, links, selected renders and SHA-256 inventories. Legacy Type1 mathematics fonts lack complete ToUnicode mappings, so extracted mathematical text is not lossless; editable TeX and rendered formulas remain authoritative. These hard reproducible checks establish only the tested properties, not perfection. Defects and uncertainties remain correctable in later immutable versions.

Historical creators: Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independent translation is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories or cited third parties.

It makes no blanket public-domain or open-license claim for the underlying mathematical work, historical French edition, NUMDAM files, bibliography or third-party content. Each source retains its exact provenance, attribution, author/source relationship, rights and licence status.
